description: This file defines the 'NetworkStatusService' class, which provides an asynchronous method to check the current network status using 'NWPathMonitor'. It includes internal mechanisms to handle timeouts and maintains internal state for task completion tracking.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: A helper class to safely track whether network status check has already been completed, ensuring thread-safe access with an NSLock.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current network status with a specified timeout, using NWPathMonitor to observe network changes.

methods.name: payload(from:)
methods.description: Creates a payload object based on the NWPath status and interface types.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Provides a default network status payload when the actual status cannot be determined within the timeout.
